     本集團不斷提高服務能力和完善服務鏈條，目前                                The Group has continued to improve its service capability and service chain.

     協同優勢，為客戶提供全業態、全週期、數字化                                venues. Longfor Smart Construction’s entrusted construction business integrates
     的「一站式解決方案」，主要包括定位策劃、虛擬                               the Group’s full-industry development experience and digital technology

     董事會現由四名執行董事、一名非執行董事及                                 The Board currently comprises four executive directors, one non-executive

                                                          strong independence element in its composition.

     於二零二二年十月二十八日委任陳序平先生為                                 Following the appointment of Mr. Chen Xuping as the Chairman of the Board
     董事會主席生效後，陳序平先生身兼本公司董                                 with effect from October 28, 2022, Mr. Chen Xuping assumes the dual roles of
     事會主席及首席執行官兩職。是項委任與守則                                 the Chairman of the Board and the Chief Executive Officer of the Company. This
     第C.2.1守則條文有所偏離，其規定主席與行                               deviates from code provision C.2.1 of the Code, which requires that the roles
     政總裁之角色應有區分，並不應由一人同時兼                                 of chairman and the chief executive officer should be separate and should not
     任。於評估本集團之發展情況並考慮陳序平先                                 be performed by the same individual. After evaluating the development of the
     生之經驗，董事會認為本公司董事會主席及首                                 Group and taking into account of the experience of Mr. Chen Xuping, the Board
     席執行官由一人同時兼任於現階段符合本公司                                 was of the opinion that it is in the best interest of the Company at the present
     之最佳利益，有利於執行本集團之發展戰略。                                 stage for vesting the roles of the Chairman of the Board and the Chief Executive
     惟董事會將不時檢討此架構並將於適當時候考                                 Officer of the Company in the same person as it helps to facilitate the execution
     慮將兩個職位分開。                                            of the Group’s development strategies. The Board will nevertheless review this
                                                          structure from time to time and will consider the segregation of the two roles as
                                                          and when appropriate.

風險管理                    RISK MANAGEMENT
有效的風險管理是本集團達致戰略目標的基本及   Effective risk management is the basic and necessary factor for achieving strategic
必要保障，為此本集團已制定《龍湖集團風險管   goals of the Group. As such, the Group has established the Risk Management
理制度》。制度中明確了本集團風險管理組織體   System of Longfor Group, which specifies the Group’s risk management
系及具體職責、風險管理整體流程、風險評估方   organizational system, detailed responsibility, overall procedures of risk
法，以及定期的風險報告機制。          management, risk assessment method and regular risk reporting mechanism.

系是董事會領導下的三道基本防線，即公司業務   system of Longfor Group consists of three basic lines of defense under the
職能部門的管理層和員工為第一道防線；由集團   leadership of the Board, namely the management and staff of business
職能負責人組成的，首席執行官為組長、首席財   departments as the first line of defense; the risk management team consisting
務官為副組長的風險管理小組為第二道防線；審   of the general manager of business departments of the Group with the CEO
核委員會、內部審計部門及安全創新部為第三道   as team leader and CFO as deputy team leader as the second line of defense;
防線。董事會是風險管理的最終責任機構，有權   and the Audit Committee, Internal Audit Department, Safe and Innovation
對集團風險管理的政策制度及應對方案進行指引   Management Department as the third line of defense. The Board shall be the
和最終決策，評估集團風險偏好，把握在戰略目   ultimate accountability body of risk management, and shall have the right to
標實現及風險管理之間的匹配度；審核委員會、   provide guidance and make final decisions on the policy, system and responding
內部審計部門及安全創新部由董事會委派，對公   plan of risk management of the Group, conduct assessment on the risk appetite
司風險管理的實施情況進行指導監控，並審閱年   of the Group and control the balance between the realization of strategic goals
度風險管理報告；風險管理小組負責不斷完善風   and risk management. The Audit Committee, Internal Audit Department,
險管理體系，執行包括風險識別、評估、應對方   Safe and Innovation Management Department are authorized by the Board to
案以及風險管理報告的管理流程，包括年度更新   advise on and monitor the implementation of risk management of the Group

匯報風險管理報告。業務部門是風險所有者，對   responsible for the ongoing improvement of risk management system as well as

因素。雖然董事會將不時考慮上述因素檢討建議    payment of dividends, and other factors that the Board may consider relevant.

  按1%至30%銷售計算的浮動租賃付款及根              lease payment that are based on 1% to 30% of sales or minimum annual
  據租期固定的最低年度租賃付款。                   lease payment that are fixed over the lease term.

  為所有租賃均以集團實體各自的功能貨                 arrangements, as all leases are denominated in the respective functional
  幣計值。租賃合約並無載列剩餘價值擔保                currencies of group entities. The lease contracts do not contain residual
  及╱或承租人於租期結束時購買物業的選                value guarantee and/or lessee’s option to purchase the property at the end
  擇權。                               of lease term.

51. 資本風險管理                    51. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT
  本集團管理資本以確保本集團的實體能持                 The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will
  續經營，同時透過優化債務及股本結餘為                 be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to
  股東帶來最大回報。                          shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.

  本集團的資本結構包括債務淨額（包括                  The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which includes,
  分別於附註30及31披露的借款及優先票                where appropriate, the borrowings and senior notes disclosed in notes
  據）、現金及現金等價物淨額以及本公司                 30 and 31 respectively, net of cash and cash equivalents and equity
  擁有人應佔權益（包括已發行股本、儲備                 attributable to owners of the Company, comprising issued share capital,
  及保留盈利）。                            reserves and retained earnings.

  本公司董事定期審閱資本架構。作為該審                 The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular
  閱的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成本及                 basis. As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider the
  與各類資本有關的風險，並採取適當措施                 cost of capital and the risks associated with each class of capital, and take
  平衡整體資本架構。                          appropriate actions to balance its overall capital structure.
